description: This file contains the AuthViewModel class that manages authentication-related functionalities in the application, implementing the ViewModel pattern for UI-related data handling.

classes.name: AuthViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class that manages the authentication state of the user through various methods for login and sign up.

classes.name: AuthUiState
classes.description: A sealed class representing different authentication UI states.

methods.name: checkAuthState
methods.description: Checks the current authentication state of the user and updates the UI state accordingly.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login with email and password, updating UI state based on the success or failure of login.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Handles user sign-up with email and password, updating UI state based on the success or failure of sign-up.

methods.name: validateInput
methods.description: Validates the provided email and password for login or sign-up.
